title: The 'bubble' energy field mapped over the property

tellings.quote: the bubble that has been mapped using lidar and other platforms

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says that a dome-like "bubble" of energy sits over the land and has been "mapped using lidar," a laser scanning tool, "and other platforms." He speaks as the man who owns the ranch and runs the work there, and if true the bubble would be a measurable physical sign of whatever happens on the property.
